Turning ideas into reusable capabilities

A practical method to connect business goals, people and technology across APIs, integrations and AI-assisted automation.

APIOps Cycles

An open method for reusable capabilities, APIs, integrations and automation.

Explore the complete interactive map and download its scalable SVG

Four cycles share stations, decisions and tools.

Different teams. Different pictures.

APIs, integrations and automation often grow in separate teams.

APIOps Cycles gives them a shared view of consumers, meaning, ownership and decisions.

Every team optimizes locally

An API and an automation use different definitions of “customer”. Their outputs cannot be combined reliably.

Agree on what “customer” means, which capabilities can be reused, and who owns the shared decisions before choosing implementations.

AI-assisted automation

AI can assist a task. Its authority, evidence and fallback need deliberate design.

The Automation Cycle helps you decide what to automate, when AI is useful, and where human review belongs.

Governance and innovation

A team needs to launch quickly. Security needs consistent controls. The platform team wants reuse.

APIOps Cycles helps them agree which decisions to make together and which can remain local.

For example: shared access rules, with local implementation choices.
